evidence_kind: automated cross-source comparison of supplied original texts; not provider review or human/independent legal review

findings.finding: D026 permits applicant-provided credit reports and references reusable reports under 1950.1; it does not establish D005 mandatory use. 1950.1 has no dedicated captured manifest source. Keep interpretation unresolved; ordinary consumer report and qualifying reusable report may differ.
D026 includes knows-or-should-know and availability now or within a reasonable period; D005 shorthand omits material qualifications.
Primary statute caps actual out-of-pocket costs plus reasonable time and CPI-adjusts $30 base from January1,1998. It does not compute the $68.96 amount; preserve D005 as reported annual amount.

Completed-application order, written criteria, concurrent-submission safeguards, applicant-selected transfer option, considered-denial qualification and routeB earlier-of-seven-days-after-selection/or30days-after-submission are supplied by captured D026, omitted from D005 summary.
Seven days after landlord receipt confirmed.

D025 specifies at most2 residential rental properties and at most4 dwelling units offered for rent, excludes prospective service members from exception and defines qualifying natural persons/family trusts. Generic owner_total_units and family_trust labels do not establish these narrower conditions.

limitations: D025/D026 were available in the original pack during this review but had not yet reached the serial extraction workflow. These are per-guidance omissions, not globally missing primary documents.
No automatic source precedence, legal resolution, cache alteration or target rule count was imposed.
Source/interpretation review and fact-registry integration remain required; no municipality or property facts were invented.
